model: Holdco look-through distributable cash capitalisation at cost of equity, segment sum-of-parts (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment line in any FY2017-FY2025 cash flow statement or H1 FY2026 interim; EquityAwardTaxes and ShareRepurchases are 0 throughout. SBC-zero HK market: house and street bases coincide.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,087,211,600 shares in issue, unchanged since at least FY2017; no options, convertibles or buybacks. Held flat.
inputs.consolidated_balance_sheet_reference: H1 FY2026 (30 Jun 2026): consolidated borrowings HK$58,923m, cash HK$24,612m, owners' equity HK$51,674m (HK$47.53/share), NCI ~HK$31.6bn (FY25). Net debt ratio 57.7% of owners' equity. NOT deducted: the valuation stream is post-interest, post-NCI and attributable, discounted at the cost of equity, so deducting consolidated net debt would charge the debt twice.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Discount rate is a COST OF EQUITY because the flows are attributable post-interest cash. HKD flows (RMB-sourced, HKD-pegged reporting): HK/US 10y risk-free ~4.0%, ERP ~6.0% for a SASAC-controlled HK-listed China conglomerate, beta ~1.0 -> 10.0% base. Bull 9.5% (SOE financing access, contracted cash flows); bear 11.0% (China property contagion, SOE governance, concession-renewal policy risk).
inputs.lease_treatment: Lease liabilities are immaterial (HK$263m at FY25; principal repayments HK$48m/yr) and sit inside segment profits already. No separate lease charge.
inputs.nci_treatment: Handled by construction: every segment flow is the Group's attributable share (SIIC Environment 49.25%, General Water of China 45%, SI Development 48.6%, SI Urban Development 43.12%, toll roads and Nanyang Tobacco 100%, Wing Fat Printing 94.29%), so consolidated NCI (HK$31.6bn) is never in the stream and is not deducted.
inputs.notes: MODEL CHOICE: Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md. SIHL straddles two rows -- it is a holdco ('Insurer, holdco' row) whose parts are operating companies. The BVPS x exit-P/B route was rejected: book (HK$47.5/share vs price HK$13.18, P/B 0.28x) is dominated by real-estate inventory, investment property and toll-road operating rights that amortise to zero by 2030, so book is not a compounding asset base. A consolidated owner-FCF DCF was rejected too: consolidated FCF (FY25 HK$8.4bn, FY22 HK$0.08bn, H1 FY26 -HK$2.3bn) swings on property presale working capital and includes ~HK$31.6bn of minority claims, and the toll-road income is finite-life. Chosen: segment sum-of-parts of the Group's ATTRIBUTABLE distributable cash, summed into one stream for the engine and capitalised at the cost of equity with net debt held at zero. ENGINE MAPPING: 'revenue' = gross attributable distributable cash before reinvestment (toll + water + consumer + real estate + head office); ebitda_margin 100%; D&A 0; 'capex' = equity funding of toll-road widening plus a sinking fund on renewed concessions; cash_tax_rate 4% = PRC dividend withholding on mainland distributions (5% treaty rate on the RMB-sourced share). SEGMENT BUILD (FY0=FY2025, HK$m): Toll roads 1,421 = NPAT 1,053 + amortisation of operating rights 821 - deferred-income credit 453 (RMB3.55bn government compensation received in cash in 2021, being released to P&L non-cash); Water/clean energy ~400 = ~700 attributable profit less the reinvestment needed to grow concession capacity (ROE ~7%, so ~40% retention for 3% growth); Consumer 756 (Nanyang Tobacco + Wing Fat, low capex, cash ~ profit); Real estate 0 cash (losses are mostly inventory impairment and IP fair-value; the listed subs pay ~nil dividends and SIHL has not funded them); Head office -50. THE CRUX is concession expiry, note 17 of FY2025 AR: Hu-Yu Expressway ends 2027, Jing-Hu 2028, Hu-Kun 2030. Widening/alteration of Hu-Yu began construction July 2026; Jing-Hu and Hu-Kun widening are in planning. Under PRC toll-road rules a reconstruction-expansion can carry a new toll period, but no extension has been disclosed. Base assumes renewal at ~60% of current cash for Hu-Yu (from FY2030) and partial renewal of Jing-Hu/Hu-Kun (from FY2032) after a gap, with HK$2.2bn of widening equity; bull assumes all three renewed near-seamlessly; bear assumes none. REAL ESTATE is carried as an equity_bridge item (HK$2.0bn, ~45% of the HK$4.5bn market value of the 48.6% SI Development and 43.12% SI Urban Development listed stakes at 2026-10-09) because those stakes are illiquid controlling blocks with ongoing losses; bear additionally charges HK$250m/yr of support for five years in the flows. CROSS-CHECK: the market (P/E ~7x trailing, P/B 0.28x) is pricing the toll cliff the reported P/E hides -- reported earnings include ~HK$340m/yr of non-cash deferred income that ends with the concessions.
inputs.listed_stake_marks_2026_10_09: 0807.HK SIIC Environment HK$0.95; 0563.HK SI Urban Development HK$0.233; 600748.SS SI Development RMB4.11 (Yahoo chart API, same timestamp as the 0363.HK price). Share counts used for the cross-check are approximate (~2.57bn, ~4.8bn, ~1.84bn).
inputs.holdco_cash_note: Canvest privatisation proceeds (~HK$4.0bn, June 2025) and SI Yangtze River Delta's ~RMB5.2bn attributable disposal cash are inside consolidated cash; no separate holdco net-cash credit is taken because the head-office yield on that cash is already within the head-office flow and part of it funded the H1 FY2026 rise in net debt ratio (48.0% -> 57.7%). This is a conservative omission of up to ~HK$3-4/share if the cash is still sitting unencumbered at the holdco.

equity_bridge.item: Real estate listed stakes (SI Development 48.6%, SI Urban Development 43.12%) at ~45% of market value
equity_bridge.note: 600748.SS RMB4.11 x ~1.84bn sh x 48.6% ~ HK$4.0bn; 0563.HK HK$0.233 x ~4.8bn sh x 43.12% ~ HK$0.5bn; haircut for illiquid controlling blocks, continuing losses (FY25 -HK$632m, H1 FY26 -HK$411m) and possible SOE support obligations

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base terminal growth; equity_5yr_cagr (2.8%) rejected because book growth is retained earnings on a P/B 0.28x base with finite-life toll assets
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR +2.8% vs revenue 5yr -5.2% and EPS 5yr -1.6% -- divergence >30%. Book grows from retention and FX while revenue shrinks with real-estate deliveries and earnings lean on disposal gains (Hangzhou Bay Bridge FY24, Canvest/SPG/SUS FY25).
historical_growth.notes: SBC is zero, so owner FCF = reported FCF - interest income. Owner FCF 3yr CAGR undefined (FY2022 base -HK$394m: property presale working-capital outflow). 5yr owner FCF CAGR 4.8% (FY2020 6,271 -> FY2025 7,910) is consolidated, includes NCI share and property working-capital swings, and is NOT the valuation base.

base.narrative: Segment cash HK$m Y1-Y10: toll 1450,1320,917,663,900,230,720,735,750,765 (Hu-Yu expires 2027 and returns at ~60% after widening from FY2030; Jing-Hu ends 2028, Hu-Kun ends 2030, both partially renewed from FY2032 at 40-50%); widening equity + sinking fund 300,500,500,500,400,400,350,250,150,150; water 420 growing 3%; consumer 600 falling 2%/yr (HK duty hikes); real estate 0; head office -50.
base.growth_rates_note: Growth of the summed gross distributable stream; the lumpy path is the concession expiry/renewal calendar, not a revenue forecast.
base.capex_pct_path_note: Widening equity and renewed-concession sinking fund as % of the gross stream.

bull.narrative: All three expressways get new toll periods tied to widening with only short gaps (toll cash 1480 dipping to 1150 in FY2031, back to 1380 by Y10) for HK$4.25bn of widening equity; water grows 5% from 450 on the environmental-health pivot; consumer holds 620; real estate stabilises and pays ~150/yr from FY2030.

bear.narrative: No toll-period extensions: toll cash 1420,1250,860,650,640 then zero from FY2031 (HK$400m of widening spend sunk in FY26-27); water 380 growing 1%; consumer 560 falling 5%/yr; real estate needs HK$250m/yr of support for five years then HK$100m/yr; head office -50.

scenario_narratives.base: SIHL's value is three different things stapled together: Shanghai toll roads that are cash cows with expiry dates (2027/2028/2030), a growing but capital-hungry minority-held water platform, and a declining-but-cash-generative HK tobacco/printing business; real estate is a drag carried at a heavy discount to the market value of its listed stakes. Base assumes the widening projects buy partial new toll periods after a gap, at lower equity returns, and the water business compounds at ~3% while consuming ~40% of its profit.
scenario_narratives.bull: Shanghai grants new toll periods on all three expressways as part of the widening programme with little interruption, water compounds at 5% as the 'environmental health' track absorbs disposal proceeds, tobacco holds up, and real estate turns to a modest contributor as core-city Shanghai stabilises.
scenario_narratives.bear: The concessions simply end: toll cash -- over half of the Group's distributable cash today -- is gone by FY2031, tobacco shrinks under repeated HK duty hikes, water growth stalls, and the property subsidiaries need ongoing support. What remains is a ~HK$0.6bn/yr water-and-tobacco holdco.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25 rather than the house 15/50/35: the single biggest driver, concession renewal on expressways expiring 2027-2030, is binary and undisclosed, and the property drag has widened two years running (FY24 -236m, FY25 -632m); against that, the Hu-Yu widening started construction in July 2026, which an operator would not normally fund 12-18 months before its concession ends without an expectation of a new toll period.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value what reaches SIHL shareholders, not what the consolidated statements show. The reported P/E of ~7x looks cheap, but ~HK$340m/yr of reported profit is non-cash release of 2021 toll compensation and the toll roads that earn over half the Group's cash have contractual end-dates within four years. The valuation is therefore a segment-by-segment attributable cash build, with the concession calendar written explicitly into the paths, capitalised at the cost of equity with no consolidated net-debt deduction.
key_risks_to_valuation: Toll-period extension on widening is assumed partially (base) or fully (bull) but has not been disclosed; if none is granted the bear case applies
Toll-company and holdco debt maturities are not separately disclosed in the extracted text; if toll subsidiaries carry debt that must be retired before concession end, toll cash is overstated
Real estate subsidiaries (listed, 43-49% owned) may require equity support; bear charges HK$1.75bn over ten years
RMB/HKD: ~all operating cash is RMB; a 5% RMB move shifts value ~5%
Holdco cash from the Canvest/SPG/SUS disposals is not credited -- upside of up to ~HK$3-4/share if it sits unencumbered at the parent
Water platform returns: SIIC Environment ROE is low; growth at 3-5% only adds value if incremental returns exceed the ~10% cost of equity

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 12.15-16.19
